items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: I know the names of Vic Gasper and Buddy Johnson.

ctx.x: Speaking of trombone, I wonder if you could talk just for a minute or two about trombone players. Who was your favorite trombone player? You mentioned much George Field, but of all the different trombonists you've heard or worked with, who were some of the greatest that you remember? The best ones, or your favorites, you might say. Either people that worked with you or others that you heard when you were a kid?

I didn't know too many trombone players. I know the names of Vic Gasper and Buddy Johnson. You know Benirap? I never did know that guy, Benirap. I mean, he was a great trombone player, but I didn't know him.
